question: deploy-service writes only platform-gitops/services/{tenant}/{service}/values.yaml, which ArgoCD syncs to the tenant's production namespace, and preview-deploy reads that same file and adds a preview id and host at apply time. For this item, should a plan with environment=preview compile that base values file (onboard creating the service directory) and leave the preview overlay to the apply item, or should onboard plans be allowed for environment=production and only production updates be refused?
reason: The issue refuses production (prod_requires_promote) but onboard necessarily creates the production values file, so which environments a plan may target, and what values_after and host mean for a preview, determine the digest contents and the refusal rules.

options: preview plans compile the base services/{tenant}/{service}/values.yaml; production refused entirely (proposal default)
allow production onboard plans; refuse only production updates
preview plans must compile the preview Helm overlay; onboard is out of scope until preview-before-onboard
